keywords: Frame 交易与隐私的三道门
EIP-7701 提议撤回并由 EIP-8141 取代

summary: nero_eth 在 ethresear.ch 分析 frame 交易（EIP-8141）如何让隐私协议不再依赖中继，以及公共内存池准入、FOCIL 执行和无状态路线这三道“门”在哪里冲突。forshtat 提交把 EIP-7701 移至 Withdrawn 的 PR，撤回原因是被 EIP-8141 取代。gakonst 宣布 Tempo Zones 上线测试网，每个 zone 都是私密的。

items.topic: 隐私与原生 AA：frame 交易的三道门
items.title: ethresear.ch：Frame 交易与隐私的三道门
items.note: 20:06（Nero_eth）：以 EIP-8141 为前提，说明 frame 交易有望消除隐私协议对中继的依赖，因为 Tornado Cash、Railgun 这类协议的取款地址是新地址、没有 ETH 支付 gas，今天只能依赖中心化、可审查的中继；但公共内存池准入规则、FOCIL 执行与无状态路线各自划定了支持哪些交易的边界，文章分析这些边界在隐私交易上的交叉与冲突。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Frame Transactions and the Three Gates to Privacy
items.note_en: 20:06 (Nero_eth): taking EIP-8141 as given, it shows frame transactions could eliminate relayers from privacy protocols, since withdrawers from protocols like Tornado Cash and Railgun use fresh addresses with no ETH for gas and today rely on centralized, censorable relayers; but public mempool admission rules, FOCIL enforcement and the statelessness roadmap each draw different boundaries around supported transactions, and the post maps where they intersect and conflict for privacy transactions.

summary_en: On ethresear.ch, nero_eth analyzed how frame transactions (EIP-8141) could free privacy protocols from relayers, and where three "gates" (public mempool admission, FOCIL enforcement and the statelessness roadmap) conflict. forshtat submitted a PR moving EIP-7701 to Withdrawn, with the reason given as superseded by EIP-8141. gakonst announced Tempo Zones on testnet, with every zone private.
